died.name: John Woolton
died.last_words: A bishop ought to die on his legs.

died.name: Nicolas Boileau-Despréaux
died.cause: to a playwright who asked him to read his new play
died.last_words: Do you wish to hasten my last hour?

died.name: Alexander II of Russia
died.cause: bleeding to death after being wounded by nihilist bomb
died.last_words: I am sweeping through the gates, washed in the blood of the Lamb.

died.name: Benjamin Harrison
died.last_words: Are the doctors here? Doctor, my lungs...

died.name: Susan B. Anthony
died.desc: American social reformer and women's rights activist
died.cause: to her chosen successor, who was worried that she would not be allowed to succeed Anthony

born.name: Joseph Priestley
born.desc: English chemist, natural philosopher and theologian
born.cause: while dictating revisions to his works
born.last_words: That is right; I have now done.

born.name: Joseph II, Holy Roman Emperor
born.last_words: Let my epitaph be, 'Here lies Joseph, who was unsuccessful in all his undertakings.'

born.name: Vince Coleman
born.cause: warning an incoming train by telegraph of the impending Halifax Explosion
born.last_words: Hold up the train. Ammunition ship afire in harbour making for Pier 6 and will explode. Guess this will be my last message. Goodbye, boys.

born.name: Donald Henry Gaskins
born.last_words: I'll let my lawyers talk for me. I'm ready to go.
